visual_identity.body: Oval, robust armored body with a glossy, 'candy-coated' shell texture. Segmented legs with tiny, rounded gripping hooks.
visual_identity.coloration: Deep metallic forest green with Maroon pinstriping along the elytra (wing covers) to match the formation's mineral palette.
visual_identity.face: Large, curious black eyes; short, segmented antennae that twitch energetically. Non-threatening, rounded mandibles.
visual_identity.texture: Subsurface scattering on the shell to give it a realistic 3D depth and high-gloss specular highlights.

anatomy_constraints: Avoid sharp spikes or aggressive pincers; maintain a 'weighty' feel in the 3D model to distinguish it from the light, airy flies.
personality: Sturdy, determined, and a bit of a 'tank'; moves with purposeful, rhythmic scurrying.
